name: Nurses Are Angels Polka Dot Box Sign (4 x 4 Inch)
seoTitle: Nurses Are Angels Box Sign, Small Nurse Gift
metaDescription: A small 4 x 4 inch box sign that reads Nurses are Angels, trimmed with polka dots. A sweet desk or shelf gift to thank a nurse who cared for your family.
summary: A small Nurses are Angels box sign with polka dot trim. A warm thank you for a nurse, sized for a desk, shelf, or nurses station.
whyItWorks: Families often want to thank the nurse who got them through a hospital stay, a birth, or a parent's final weeks, and they are not sure what to give. A small sign with a kind message is a gentle, appropriate choice. It does not cross any lines the way cash or a big personal gift can, and it gives the nurse something to set by her computer or in her kitchen that reminds her the work mattered.

At four inches square, it fits easily on a crowded nurses station counter, a charting desk, or a windowsill at home. The polka dot trim keeps it from feeling too sentimental. It also works for a retirement party, a Nurses Week table, or as a small item in a unit gift basket. We like it paired with a handwritten note, since the card is often the part nurses keep for years.
goodToKnow: The sign is 4 x 4 inches, so it is a small accent piece rather than wall art.
Check the listing photos for the colors of the polka dot trim to match her style.
A handwritten thank you note makes it far more meaningful.

faq.q: Is this an appropriate gift for a nurse who cared for a family member?
faq.a: Yes, a small sign with a kind message is a common and welcome thank you. Many hospitals discourage expensive gifts, so modest items like this are a safe choice.

faq.q: Can it be displayed at work?
faq.a: Its small size makes it easy to set on a nurses station or charting desk. Some units have rules about personal decor, so it may end up at home instead.
